text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown states the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 following a Finance Committee revision in December 2026.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 to account for additional smart TV integration costs not included in the original scope."}]},{"text":"The originally approved total budget was $2,400,000, so the adjustment is an increase of $200,000.","kind":"derived","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Total | $1,700,000 | $460,000 | $240,000 | $2,400,000"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000"}]},{"text":"The Team & Governance Document states that budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"GOV-p1-s2","quote":"Decisions requiring budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation."}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown states the Finance Committee itself revised the budget in December 2026, so the required body was involved in the change.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000"}]}],"conflicts":[],"missing":[],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
